final_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: CHMURNIK campaign cloud panorama, one clean image, NEW artwork.
Create a 9:4 wide single continuous panoramic sky above an olive miniature landscape. Sweeping ivory cumulus has three distinct sculptural lobes across the width. Include wispy high cloud at upper left, a huge sunlit billow in the center, and a violet distant rain curtain at the far right. The upper 30 percent is calm, clean open sky. This one coherent continuous landscape will later be split into THREE contiguous vertical cover tiles: give all three thirds interesting large elements without any hard tile boundaries, panels, triptych treatment, seams, dividers or borders. This is not a scientific cloud-genus identification plate.
Style/medium: sophisticated adult editorial art direction, tactile wool-felt clouds and cut-paper miniature olive terrain; refined sculptural forms, visibly delicate natural wool fibers and paper edges, not childish. Take the inspected coastal reference only as inspiration for restrained luminous light, tactile landscape depth and subtle natural textures, not its photographic nighttime subject.
Color palette: cream ivory, warm blush-pink sky, olive terrain, restrained violet atmospheric accents.
Lighting/mood: soft warm afternoon side light, luminous and restrained, calm atmospheric depth, strong graphic composition.
Constraints: exactly one seamless panoramic image in 9:4 aspect ratio, preferably 2304 x 1024 pixels. No faces, no characters, no people, no text, no labels, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no fake UI, no contact sheet.
